SELECT /*selectExportExBlExportBlProcDetail*/ HD.BUYER ,(SELECT CM.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CM WHERE CM.COM_CODE = HD.BUYER) AS BUYER_NM , HD.FORWARDER , (SELECT COD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'EP01' AND COD.CODE = HD.FORWARDER) AS FORWARDER_NM , HD.CI_NO , HD.CI_DATE , HD.CURRENCY_CODE , HD.ITEM_AMT , HD.TOTAL_WEIGHT AS GROSS_WEIGHT , HD.PACKING_WEIGHT , HD.PACKING_UNIT , (SELECT COD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'EP05' AND COD.CODE = HD.PACKING_UNIT) AS PACKING_UNIT_NM , (SELECT SUM(INV_QTY) FROM KEP_EXP_CIDT DT WHERE DT.PKG_COMPANY_CODE = HD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE AND DT.BUYER = HD.BUYER AND DT.AGENT = HD.AGENT AND DT.CI_NO = HD.CI_NO AND DT.STATUS != 'D') AS SUM_INV_QTY , HD.NOTIFY_PARTY , HD.SHIP_METHOD , HD.PORT_OF_LOADING , HD.FINAL_DESTINATION FROM KEP_EXP_CIHD HD WHERE HD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE =#{st_pkg_cmpy_no} AND HD.STATUS != 'D'
AND HD.BUYER||HD.CI_NO IN
#{item}
ORDER BY HD.CI_NO
